title: Collapse flash_path/fsdir_path and keystore/fsdir_keystore in g_slots; merge slot_add
description: g_slots has flash_path[256] and fsdir_path[256] which both store .p11k file paths. Collapse to keystore_path[256] under combined #if defined(USB_FLASH)||defined(FSDIR) guard. Merge keystore and fsdir_keystore pointers into one keystore pointer. Update all 40+ call sites in wp11_pkcs11.c (mechanical rename). Merge slot_add_flash/slot_add_fsdir into slot_add_keystore(path, proto) -- only differs in which field it writes and which proto it sets. Keep soft_pin/soft_pin_len under WOLFP11_CFG_USB_FLASH_BACKEND guard (only used by soft persistent token).
